title: En Aasai Rasave
desc: A young boy, working as a street dancer, discovers that his mother is still alive, so he plans to locate her and reunite her with his father.

title: Ramachandra
desc: Due to his honesty and refusal to meet the demands of those in power, Inspector Ramachandran is often transferred from one town to another. Soon, he finds himself in an area that is highly terrorised.

title: Nam Nadu
desc: Muthazhagu, an honest youth leader, opposes his corrupt politician father, Aalavandhar, who aspires to become the chief minister by bullying the villagers.

title: Kaadhal Parisu
desc: Sisters Malini and Chitra are heirs to a huge fortune. Chitra is in for a shock when she introduces her boyfriend to Malini and the latter accuses him of raping her years ago.

title: Em Mahan
desc: Krishna is always worried and sad as his strict father does not miss a chance to scold him. His father goes overboard by chasing him out of the house when he learns about Krishna's love life.

title: Pachchak Kuthira
desc: A man, living in slums, is infamous for annoying people and is unaware that the people hate him. However, as he finally realises this he wholeheartedly decides to transform himself.

title: Piragu
desc: Sathya, an aspiring film director, moves to Chennai to pursue his dream. However, his life takes a complicated turn when he is targeted by two rival gangs.

title: Pirappu
desc: Padma's father pushes for her engagement to Kannan despite his dislike for him. However, things spiral out of control when Kannan refuses, as he is in love with another woman.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Ethir Kaatru
desc: A dubious financial company uses an unemployed youth as a scapegoat to conceal their fraudulent business. However, his suspicious death compels a journalist to expose the firm's deceptive practices.
